state:
Milestone `dossier`, goal `the-description-is-owed`, stage 2. `data/proofs/policy.json` carries
`owes.all.about: true`, so `bun nv proofs --gate` counts a missing or misshapen `about.md`. It names
26 of 1159 features: the 13 sections of `tools:config`, which owe a description and nothing else,
and 13 features that owe more than a description. Every section of `tools:editor`, `tools:agents`,
`tools:php-differences` and `tools:cli` has its description, and so has
`tools:server/what-reaches-a-running-server`.

**The chain order cannot reach this goal as it stands.** Its check is the whole roster, and the 13
features are the 5 of `tools:install` and 8 of `tools:server`, which owe a test, an example and an
attack as well, and five of them a code sample in their reference section. Goals `tools-install`
and `tools-server` own those and sit behind this goal on the chain, and only the driver moves
`live`. Nothing is blocked until the `tools:config` descriptions are written; after that the run
needs the user to reorder the chain, and the status line should then be `BLOCKED`.

**One call made for the user, to look at** (carried forward, not re-checked this session). Gap
`nvs-ir/throws-on-an-array-key-that` was moved from owner goal `coalesce-assign` back to
`milestone: M10` so the `owners` step of `bun nv verify` passes, and
`docs/agent/goals/coalesce-assign.md` still has that goal delete it.

The pack does not print `docs/examples/README.md` § *The description*; it is one `bun nv peek`.
A group is checked with `bun nv proofs --gate --group '<G>'`; `--only` takes feature ids alone.
A whole tools chapter is one `bun nv peek <chapter>:<first>-<last>` and costs about 10k tokens, so
one chapter's descriptions fit a session and two chapters fit most.
